test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
In the following sentence the underlined part contains an error. Alternatives to the underlined part are given as options. Select the correct alternative.

Mary is the __quieter__ student of the class.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. quietest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When comparing one individual against all others in a group, the **superlative** form is used, which is formed by adding "**-est**" to the word.
 
• The sentence refers to Mary being compared with the rest of the class, implying the need for the superlative form "**quietest**."
 
• The given sentence incorrectly uses "quieter," which is the **comparative **form used for comparing two entities, not one against a group.

Correct sentence: *Mary is the **quietest** student of the class.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**

 
 
• Used to compare two entities.
 
• Formed by adding "**-er**" to single-syllable adjectives (e.g., quieter) or by using "more" for multi-syllable adjectives (e.g., more beautiful).
 
 
 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• Used to compare one entity against a group.
 
• Formed by adding "**-est**" to single-syllable adjectives (e.g., quietest) or by using "most" for multi-syllable adjectives (e.g., most beautiful).
